items.title: 56679_Arthur Briggs oral history interview
items.q: And Mr. Sayag hired me to form an orchestra for "The Sportin'", in Monte Carlo.

ctx.x: Well, that's very interesting. I'd like you to tell us about that.
Well, I reformed an orchestra. When Noble Sissle went back to the United States, I was asked to form an orchestra, by Mr. Sayag, the same man we worked for, for Ciro's.
